PR #2737 (TASK-1766) rework round 1 -> 2 is pushed and ready for re-review.

Head is 42aa92cc63 on agy/task-1766. origin/main merged cleanly; make check-ci-fast passes 30 of 30 gates.
- BLOCKING formatting: fixed in c5d63200dd. cargo fmt --all did not reach the file, so rustfmt was also run on lib_part*.rs.
- Duplicated hex-SHA rule: now one shared helper, aida_core::mailbox::looks_like_hex_sha (42aa92cc63).
- Code-span test: now exercises the production extract_mention_candidates (42aa92cc63).
- Deferred to TASK-1918 (draft, low): one-shot phantom cleanup instead of a side effect of 'mailbox list', re-routing whitespace-padded direct mail, roster check before the SHA rule, and the test gaps.
Finding -> fix table: https://github.com/joemooney/aida/pull/2737#issuecomment-6253539251
Worktree removed; agy/task-1766 is not checked out anywhere. Not merged.
subject: PR #2737 ready for re-review (TASK-1766)
